QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set, the compiler is GNU-compatible (`__GNUC__`, including clang), and the target is one of the four supported architectures.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler and architecture predefined macros, which conveys that it is derived. It never says outright that the macro is absent from mbedtls_config.h.
